idk. off maybe. i keep getting this knot in my stomach and i cant tell why

tense. like im bracing for something. theres this work thing on monday and i cant stop thinking about it

worry mostly. they want me to present to the whole department and i just keep thinking everyones gonna realise i dont actually know what im doing

the second one. ive been there two years and i still feel like i snuck in somehow. like one good presentation and theyll finally see i belong or one bad one and the whole thing falls apart

fear that one mistake cracks everything. its stupid i know. logically im fine at my job. but it never feels like enough. like im always one slip from being found out

i dont know if i can look at that right now. its a lot. i think i just needed to say it out loud to someone
